structured.answer: If I have to pick, I'd take option 2, "קיבוץ לפי חברה". Each company gets its own heading with what it charges, "דמי ניהול מהחיסכון: מ־0.54% עד 0.61%", and then all its tracks underneath, so I can look at one company at a time. But I'm not putting money into any of this before I talk to you or the bank. I never got to option 3, the one they marked "מומלץ".

stuck.why: It wasn't clear to me whether these were three different pages or three ways of showing the same thing. One of them had a green 'מומלץ' tag, and I couldn't tell who was recommending it or why.

stuck.where: Screen 2, the first table of option 1
stuck.why: It opens with 'עוקב מדד s&p 500'. That's English letters and shares, which is exactly what I'm afraid of. I nearly left right there.
A coloured ring next to 'מניות' and 'מט"ח' with percentages. I didn't know if 99% was good or bad, and the two dot colours look almost the same to me.

stuck.where: Screens 5–6, the long lists of הראל and מור
stuck.why: Rows and rows of numbers. I got tired and anxious and stopped after the sixth screen.

used: Title 'כל המסלולים בכל החברות: איך רואים את החברות' and the line 'קופת גמל להשקעה: 143 מסלולים של 12 חברות'
The option buttons '1. החברה בראש השורה', '2. קיבוץ לפי חברה', '3. טבלת חברות מול סוגים (מומלץ)'
The company heading row in option 2: 'הראל 16 מסלולים · נכסים 19.1 מיליארד ₪ · דמי ניהול מהחיסכון: מ־0.54% עד 0.61%'
Track names I recognise, such as 'אג"ח ממשלתי', 'אג"ח סחיר' and 'כספי (שקלי)'
skimmed: The pill buttons for 'במה הכסף מושקע' and the 'מיון לפי' buttons
The 'תשואה שנתית ממוצעת' column ('3 שנים 13.70%', 'פחות מ־3 שנים')
The 'נכסים' column in millions and billions
The explanatory lines under the tabs (long lines, I lost my place in the middle)
skipped: Screens 7–10, including option 3 'טבלת חברות מול סוגים', because I was tired
The 'מקור / מדריכים / חוקים וכללים / שאלות' tabs
The 'קופה' number column (13874 and so on)
The 'משותף לשלוש, ומה שהנתונים מראים' link and 'מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה'
unsure_meaning: the coloured circles and dots next to 'מניות' and 'מט"ח'
'פחות מ־3 שנים' in the returns column
קופת גמל להשקעה itself: is it like a deposit, or is it shares?
not_found: Any word about whether this is as safe as a bank deposit
My bank, or any bank at all; the only companies are insurance and investment houses (הראל, מגדל, מור, אלטשולר שחם...)
A simple sentence that says which company is cheaper
A comparison with the interest on a deposit

findings.what: The page opens with S&P 500 and shares. To someone who looks for safe saving, it says 'this isn't for you' straight away.
findings.where: Screen 2, top of the option 1 table

findings.what: Dark background with small, pale grey text. Even with my glasses on I struggled with the column headings and the notes.
findings.where: The whole page, especially the table headings and the notes under the tables

findings.what: Far too many numbers in each row: two fees, two percentages, two returns, assets. It made me anxious.
The circles and the two dot colours (turquoise and yellow) are close together, and I can't tell what they mean.
The option marked 'מומלץ' is at the very bottom. I never got that far.
findings.where: Option button 3 on screen 1; its content is after screen 6

findings.what: In option 2 the company heading with its fee range ('מ־0.54% עד 0.61%') is the most useful thing on the page, but it gets lost among 16 rows.
findings.where: Screen 4, the הראל heading row; screen 6, the מור heading row

findings.what: No company I'd recognise as 'my bank'. The names aren't familiar enough for me to trust them with money.
findings.where: Company names in all the tables

findings.what: The long explanatory lines run the full width of the screen, and I lose my place in the middle.
findings.where: The explanations under the option buttons and under the tables
